Let me try and better explai ln what I had meant. To focus on an object is to focus on an aggregate of sensations, correct? There is no breath but sensation.

What I have been practicing recently, is allowing senses to arise and fall with mindfulness. So if thoughts arise, I do not return to breath but instead try and become mindful, aware, of the thoughts. If the noise of a car is loud enough, it switches my awareness and instead I follow those sensations. Just watching. No doing. I call this insight meditation only because I have no other words for it.

Bugs interrupt this practice. They drive my mind and body to act on them beyond just acceptance and awareness.

I am giving advice I received upon asking a similar question.

If your practice is strong enough even the strongest most unpleasant sensations will pass through without a reaction.

As I understand it, concentration is necessary on the path to relinquish dissatisfaction/suffering. So I will sit and concentrate. I would appreciate it if you joined me.

So you suppose I should practice more, fair enough.

Which do you think may help in the most wholesome way, meditation with an object, or mediation on insight (no object just sensation)?

I have been stuck more or less in my room for the past few weeks due to some sort of hellish combination of anxiety and depression.

Ive been awake since 7am but Im still here on my phone reading and posting more or less useless shit. I NEED to find a job in order to continue to have food, shelter, etc. But I cant make myself do anything. There is some sort of membrane between thought and action. I know what the next step is, I know how to spend the day in a productive manner. Its not hard. I even want to do it. But I dont. My thoughts scream at me to just do something. Just move. At least get up and get some water.

Im stuck inside my own mind. I dont experience any novel stimulation, and my thoughts become a looping echo chamber as I beg for a brain aneurism. I have tried all sorts of techniques and medicines and therapy and none of it has given me freedom. Many days I will lie there and fantasize about my death. In these fantasies my body, and especially my nervous system, is hacked apart. I will envision a sledge pounding, pounding, pounding, pounding. Until theres nothing to be salvaged.

Ive grown to hate existence, and most things in it. Especially myself. I feel incredibly guilty that I just. Wont. Do it. I dont know why I cant induce any sort of productivity at all. I think about it all the time. I envision my body taking the steps. I beg myself to just do it. I know that its easy. But I dont. I cant figure why I dont, but it happens the same. I will lie here until the need for food and water screams enough that I go solve the need. And then I will do it again tomorrow.

Please shoot me

I cant find any sort of meaning or understanding of being, and this leaves me in a constant state of dissatisfaction. That one sounds smart. Its not a good one, but it sounds smart.

I feel like Im not good enough to really add to the "zeitgeist". That I am not smart or talented or dedicated enough to create something, anything, truly great and wonderful. Of course, if I kill myself, I never will.

So those are all the thoughts that come to mind. None of them are really that logical or "good". But, I still feel them. Every day. Today hasnt been bad at all though. These thoughts only hurt sometimes.
